title: Modified free gingival graft technique for treatment of gingival recession defects at mandibular incisors: A randomized clinical trial
authors: Carcuac O, Trullenque -Eriksson A, Derks J. J Periodontol. 2023 Jun;94(6):722 -730. doi: 10.1002/JPER.22-0581. [Epub 2023 Jan 30] * collacone®
supports: Clinical study from the botiss collacone / collafleece (collagen cone and fleece) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “ModFGG represents a valid approach for the management of RT1 recession defects at mandibular incisors. The technique is superior to traditional FGG in terms of root coverage, the gain of keratinized tissue height, and patient satisfaction” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
